mi355x-4gpu.notes: Derived 2026-10-10: this case's default command plus the cookbook builder's mi300x/mi355x backend flags. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured on this hardware. MINIMAX_H3_VAE_DECODER_FUSED_NORM=0 (2026-10-10, MI355X, sglang 3831e7e09): the VAE decoder's fused scale-add RMSNorm Triton kernels (#41906) use PTX inline asm (mul.rn.f32, constraint 'f') from sglang/kernels/numerics.py; on ROCm they fail to compile and decode to an all-NaN video. The flag keeps the eager norm path, which computes the same values.
mi355x-4gpu.policy_exception: Same correctness exception as the default profile (checked 2026-08-07): MiniMax-H3's torch.compile path changes numerical output per the sglang cookbook, so it is excluded regardless of hardware.

vllm-omni.reason: Empirically validated 2026-08-07, first on minimax-h3-5090-2gpu-v4 (2x RTX 5090) then on 2xB200: the default (compiled) profile segfaults identically on both GPU classes 1 step into denoising (see command_profiles.default.notes) -- a confirmed hardware-independent vLLM-Omni bug, despite the recipe's own claim that torch.compile is 'not enabled by default on consumer paths.' --enforce-eager avoids that segfault, but on RTX 5090 it fails differently at startup (a diffusion worker process dies before completing its init handshake, surfaced as EOFError) and never completes a request on that GPU class. On 2xB200 the identical --enforce-eager command works cleanly and completes a correct generation -- see command_profiles.b200-2gpu for the validated numbers and the sglang comparison on the same hardware. Net: vLLM-Omni H3 support is real but fragile below the B200 class tested here; RTX 5090 has no working profile for this case in either variant.

default.description: LightX2V's four-GPU MiniMax-H3 preset made resident and compiled: Ulysses SP4, world-TP text encoder, tile-parallel VAE decode, FlashAttention 3 (Hopper).

upstream_recipe.section: SP4 preset, the default of scripts/minimax_h3/run_minimax_h3_t2av_parallel.sh; served per 'Server and POST' with --model-variant fl2av

default.notes: VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-08): derived offline from LightX2V main 0c2edc12, never run. configs/minimax_h3/minimax_h3_sp.json is the four-GPU preset scripts/minimax_h3/run_minimax_h3_t2av_parallel.sh launches by default (SP4, Ulysses), served as scripts/minimax_h3/server/start_server.sh does (--model-variant fl2av, no startup --task, each request names task t2av); pure Ulysses 4 is also the topology sglang and vLLM-Omni run for this case. Kept from the preset: SP4 Ulysses, tile-parallel VAE decode, sgl-kernel RMSNorm, no feature caching. cpu_offload, text_encoder_cpu_offload and vae_cpu_offload false (preset: all true) on 141+ GB cards, and text_encoder_tensor_parallel true: the preset offloads a replicated text encoder, which resident would put up to 62 GiB more on every GPU next to the 62 GiB replicated DiT; sharding it over the world group is what upstream's SP8 configs do (minimax_h3_ref2av_sp_sol_5090.json). Deviations from the preset, all for the benchmark's lossless policy: attn_type flash_attn3 in place of sage_attn2 (int8-QK SageAttention, a different numeric class; FA3 is the fastest exact kernel on Hopper); use_compile true (harness default) with rope_type torch_real_rope, the pairing of upstream's compile preset configs/minimax_h3/minimax_h3_compile.json (an eager run should go back to minimax_h3_triton_rope), but warmup false: that preset's startup warmup compiles at 480x480x158 and 544x960x124, and under torch.compile(dynamic=None) the second shape recompiles every block shape-dynamic, so the case's shape would be served by that dynamic graph -- the harness warms at the measured shape instead; use_adaln_cache false (the preset's true is required only with cpu_offload): that cache serves the ~13B-parameter, timestep-only AdaLN projections from an offline artifact built for one schedule, while sglang runs the standard path in this benchmark (its --minimax-h3-adaln-cache-path is off too), and the projections it skips are a bandwidth-bound read of about 24 GiB of weights per step, split across TP ranks (est. 0.1-0.4% of a step); infer_steps 49 (preset: 29): LightX2V counts DiT evaluations on linspace(1, 0, infer_steps + 1), sglang's num_inference_steps 50 counts the points of linspace(1, 0, 50), so both run the same 49 forwards on the same grid, shifted 12 (video) / 3 (audio). size and num_frames come from each request ([768, 1344], 124). Weights: the repo's Diffusers-layout components (sglang reads the native FL2VA/ and Ref2VA/ partitions of the same repo and revision -- the same checkpoint, packaged twice by MiniMax); model_allow_patterns fetches only what LightX2V reads. Resident per GPU: DiT ~62 GiB (replicated under SP) + text encoder <= 16 GiB + VAEs ~10 GiB. First GPU round: A/B TP2 x SP2 (configs/minimax_h3/minimax_h3_tp_sp.json: parallel {tensor_p_size: 2, seq_p_size: 2, seq_p_attn_type: ulysses}) against SP4, and vae_use_compile true against off. Needs LightX2V >= 9ea22feb (2026-09-10, --model-variant); the installer's default pin 7efd05f8 predates H3, so a round sets LIGHTX2V_INSTALL_SPEC to main.

blackwell-sp4-fa2.notes: VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-08). flash_attn3 is a Hopper-only kernel; FlashAttention 2 (source-built for sm_100) is what every LightX2V Blackwell profile here runs, the same exact-softmax class. Untested alternative: torch_sdpa (cuDNN / flash SDPA, what sglang resolves for H3 on B200). Otherwise the default profile; see its notes.

trtllm-visual.reason: trtllm-visual's tracked scope in this harness is image cases; H3 is a video+audio model.

diffusers.reason: MiniMax-H3 is integrated as Modular Diffusers blocks only (no DiffusionPipeline), and only via an unmerged PR (huggingface/diffusers#14355 -- pip install git+.../diffusers.git@refs/pull/14355/head). Not a servable baseline path today.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI has no sequence or tensor parallelism (its one multi-GPU path splits CFG branches, and H3 runs without CFG), so a four-GPU cell would be its one-GPU number; that number is in minimax_h3_t2va_5s.

default.description: Hopper (H200): base H3 T2VA, Ulysses 4, DiT FSDP-sharded, text encoder and VAEs resident, regional DiT compile, FA3.
default.framework_ref: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1 on 2026-10-07) installed `.[fasth3]` with uv: fastvideo-kernel 0.3.5 built from the same checkout, flash-attn-4 @14c37795, torch 2.12.0+cu130; FA3 from the prebuilt torch212-cu130 artifact
default.serve_args: --generator.engine.use_fsdp_inference true --generator.engine.parallelism.tp_size 1 --generator.engine.parallelism.sp_size 4 --generator.engine.offload.dit false --generator.engine.offload.dit_layerwise false --generator.engine.offload.text_encoder false --generator.engine.offload.image_encoder false --generator.engine.offload.vae false --generator.engine.offload.lazy_module_load false --generator.engine.compile.enabled false --generator.engine.compile.vae_enabled false --generator.pipeline.workload_type t2v --generator.pipeline.experimental.attention_backend FLASH_ATTN --generator.pipeline.experimental.inference_torch_compile true --generator.pipeline.experimental.h3_sequential_load false --generator.pipeline.experimental.vae_parallel_decode true --generator.pipeline.experimental.vae_parallel_decode_strategy gather
default.notes: Derived 2026-10-08 from FastVideo's T2VA recipe (SP = num_gpus, FSDP DiT, text encoder and VAE offloaded, eager DiT) for a resident server: no offload, `inference_torch_compile` (FastVideo's regional per-block compile, safe on FA2/FA3/FA4), VAE uncompiled so #1930's bitwise tile split runs. #1930/#1807's bit-identical switches are on (exact RoPE/AdaLN/SwiGLU kernels, VAE tile split, fused Ulysses all-to-all) and the output-changing ones off (FP32 round-once H3 fusions, FA4 packed varlen). The DiT stays FSDP-sharded on Hopper: replicated, the 66.3 GB DiT, the resident 66.7 GB Qwen3-VL and the 11 GB of VAEs come to 144 GB, more than a 141 GB H200 holds. FA3 is what FastVideo's FLASH_ATTN loads when FASTVIDEO_FA4=0 and flash_attn_interface imports; without it FastVideo falls back to SDPA silently. Steps: FastVideo counts sigma grid points as sglang does (scheduling_minimax_h3.py: linspace(1, 0, num_inference_steps)), so 50 runs 49 forwards, as on sglang; vLLM-Omni counts evaluations and runs 50 for the same field. The 12/3 shifts come from the checkpoint's scheduler configs: FastVideo rejects a flow_shift for H3. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-08): check the log for 'Using FlashAttention-3 backend', that compile happens inside the harness warmups, and A/B against DIFFUSION_BENCH_DISABLE_TORCH_COMPILE=1 (eager, where the exact kernels take over).

_note: vLLM-Omni requests carry extra_params.preencode_mp4=true (2026-10-08): its documented, off-by-default overlap of MP4 encoding with the VAE decode (byte-identical frames), the counterpart of sglang's default streamed encode (#41819). Both engines run their best documented output path. vLLM-Omni gets num_inference_steps 49 (2026-10-08): since vllm-omni #7219 (2026-09-24) it reads N as N model passes on linspace(1, 0, N+1), while sglang, FastVideo and LightX2V's 49 read 50 as 50 sigma grid points, i.e. 49 passes; 49 gives Omni the identical 50-point grid. Earlier H3 rounds ran Omni one pass more.
